<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #f3f5f8; --surface: #ffffff; --surface-2: #f7f9fb; --text: #18222d; --muted: #5b6878;

    --ok: #17794a; --ok-soft: #e1f3e8; --warn: #8f5600; --warn-soft: #fcf0d9; --bad: #b42318; --bad-soft: #fde9e7;

    color-scheme: light dark;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root {
      --bg: #0e151c; --surface: #151f29; --surface-2: #1a2632; --text: #e4ebf2; --muted: #98a6b5;

    }
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }

  html, body { margin: 0; }

    background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); line-height: 1.45; font-size: 14.5px;
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  a { color: var(--primary); }
